mission.title: Illustrative invoice discrepancy review
mission.objective: Analyze this fictional invoice discrepancy and propose evidence needed before contacting a supplier. No actual provider or invoice is represented; do not send messages or make payments.

sources.title: Fictional invoice
sources.text: Synthetic example: the invoice lists 120 units at one dollar per unit. The total is 120 dollars.

sources.title: Fictional usage record
sources.text: Synthetic example: a local usage log contains 80 units for the same stated period. Completeness and billing definitions have not been independently checked.

opportunities.title: Investigate the apparent billing discrepancy
opportunities.rationale: Illustrative assumptions only. A discrepancy is not proof of overbilling; definitions, missing records, taxes and billing periods require review.
